description: This Java class 'MacroScreenViewHandler' extends 'AbstractViewHandler' and manages the rendering process for screen views in OFBiz. It initializes rendering components based on themes, handles output compression, and coordinates the rendering of screen, form, menu, and tree components using macros.

classes.name: MacroScreenViewHandler
classes.description: A view handler for rendering screens in OFBiz with macro-based themes, supporting dynamic theme-based component loading, output compression, and macro rendering coordination.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view handler with the given servlet context.

methods.name: loadRenderers
methods.description: Loads macro-based renderers for screen, form, menu, and tree components based on the current theme and request context.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares and returns a context map for the view, populated with request-specific data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Handles rendering a specified page within a content type, applying optional compression, and coordinating the rendering process.
